title: Strong Couples Project: Disseminating Evidence-based Relationship Education
official: Strong Couples Project: ePREP Nationwide Dissemination
summary: The current research is designed to implement and evaluate the ePREP relationship intervention with couples via the Cooperative Extension system.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Resident of Illinois
* Married, engaged, or living with their partner for at least 6 months
* Both partners willing to participate in online relationship-focused programming

Exclusion Criteria:

* One or both partners reports sever forms of intimate partner violence occurring in the relationship
